question.text: An investor submits a subscription request for INR 2 crore to Nilgiri Multi-Strategy Fund (open-ended Cat III AIF) at 2:00 PM on Monday, 20 April 2026. The PPM specifies a 3:00 PM IST cut-off with T-day NAV applicable to requests received before cut-off. Monday's T-day NAV (post market close) is Rs. 1,250. Tuesday's NAV is Rs. 1,260. How many units does the investor receive?

explanation.text: The Logic: Applying the PPM-stated cut-off/NAV rule, the request received at 2:00 PM (before the 3:00 PM cut-off) gets T-day NAV = Rs. 1,250. Units = INR 2,00,00,000 / 1,250 = 16,000 units. The Trap: Option B uses Tuesday's NAV (the PPM gives T-day NAV to pre-cut-off requests). Option C is a decimal error (2 cr / 1,250 = 16,000, not 1,600). Option D uses a wrong divisor. Note: The workbook (pp. 83, 125, 332) supports PPM-specified NAV cadence and NAV-per-unit arithmetic. The specific cut-off/T-day rule in this item is the scheme's PPM assumption, not a uniform workbook rule.
